Class ItemsReturnedEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
de.eldoria.companies.events.player.ItemsReturnedEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerProvider<org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer>
public class ItemsReturnedEvent extends org.bukkit.event.Event implements PlayerProvider<org.bukkit.OfflinePlayer>
Items were put into a player's returned items, which the player picks up with /order collect.

Fired after the items were stored, usually off the main thread; the event may be asynchronous. It fires only on the server where the items were returned; expired orders are handled on the primary server of a network.

Orders are anonymous: when items return to a worker, never show the worker who owned the order.
